transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well... I guess I've been having some trouble following things. Like, people at the museum will be talking right to me about the next art walk, and... I’ll be looking right at them, but then I realize I missed the middle of what they said. I just have to ask them to run it by me again. That's mostly it.
Do you have trouble hearing what people say?
No, my hearing is fine. I just... I don't know. I just miss things sometimes.
Did you have this same kind of trouble paying attention when you were a child?

I suppose so. I remember... my report cards used to say things like I was daydreaming or needed reminders to finish my work. And my mother... she used to have to sit right next to me when I did my homework, just to keep me at it. That was before I was twelve, I think. So, yes.
Do you have the same kind of trouble paying attention in other parts of your life, like at home or when doing chores?

I suppose so. Like... if they give me a list of things to do for the volunteer group, I'll get the first part done. I'll print the maps out. But then... I might not remember to call the desk, or I'll just leave the folders sitting there half-done. Usually until someone mentions it.
Have these attention problems ever caused you to lose a job or get in serious trouble at work?

Well, I haven't worked a regular job in a while. But... I suppose at the museum, where I volunteer, it's been noticed. They've had to sort of... quietly shift some of the planning pieces away from me. And... I don't know, I just stopped feeling confident leading the art walks the way I used to. So it's affected things a bit, I guess.
Have you noticed your memory or thinking getting worse over time?
I don't think so. I mean... I still remember things fine. It's just... keeping my mind on what I'm doing that's the trouble. But my memory itself... no, I haven't noticed it getting worse.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I mean, I'm fine. I don't really get down like that. Just... normal, I suppose.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things, I suppose. But... no, I wouldn't say I'm an anxious person. Just... average, I guess.
Do you often act or speak before thinking?
No... I wouldn't say so. I'm usually pretty quiet. I don't really... blurt things out or jump the gun, if that's what you mean.
Do these attention problems interfere with managing things at home, like paying bills or keeping track of appointments?

Well... I suppose it comes up a bit. Not so much with bills... but, well, at the museum. I volunteer there. They've... quietly moved some of the planning stuff to other people. And I just... I don't feel as comfortable leading the art walks anymore. It's just... gotten harder to keep it all straight.
